◆ comBufGainSel

rlUInt8_t rlRfPALoopbackCfg_t::comBufGainSel

This field configures the QPSK buffer gain in both the PA and the LO loopback paths in xWR294x/xWR254x/xWR2x4xECO/xWR2x4xP.
.

Note
: Please refer to COMMON_BUF_GAIN_SEL field in AWR_LOOPBACK_BURST_CONF_SET_SB for the list of gain codes.
